note: [L] carries the equation direction with Slate.medium and Slate.aspiring (j_i -> -v_eom, v_eq -> v_eom), and uses Terrace.Lease_alive for rho_tr(v_eom)=0. The bound |rho_tr(j_i)| <= C e^{-h_k/4} appears instead as the rate taxA*(Lease(Shine5 L.Z) - Lease(Vivid)) -> 0 in Slate.diadem, and filter limits replace the joint cluster choice.

lemma aspiring : Tendsto (medium L X Z) atTop (𝓝 (Stem5 (Zᵣ))) ∧ Tendsto (fun k=> taxA (A) k * Lease Zᵣ h (medium L X Z k)) atTop (𝓝 0):=by
    obtain ⟨q,hq,hR,hV⟩:= penumbra P h hb hu hz hp; let f(k):=(Z.β k)⁻¹; let v:= Shine5 Z X; let w:= Shine5 Z L.Z
    have he:Tendsto (fun i=> f i • v i) atTop (𝓝 0):=by
       apply tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero.mpr; refine squeeze_zero' (Eventually.of_forall fun i=>norm_nonneg _) ?_ (g:=fun i=> q*(Pig A i*(Z.β i)⁻¹)) ?_
       · filter_upwards [hR] with i hi; have hp:f i ≥0:=inv_nonneg.mpr (measured hb P hz i|>.le); rw [norm_smul,Real.norm_of_nonneg hp]; exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hi hp).trans_eq (by unfold f; ring)
       simpa [Pig] using! (washout P h hb hz (1/6)).const_mul q
    let y:= taxA (A); let ρ:=Lease Zᵣ h; have hx : Vivid (Zᵣ) (BornZ none)= -Stem5 (Zᵣ):=Vivid_z _
    have hv':ρ (Vivid (Zᵣ) (BornZ none))=0:=by rw[hx,map_neg, show ρ (Stem5 _)=0 from Lease_alive .., neg_zero]
    have hZ:= (continuous_snd.continuousAt).tendsto.comp (tiara P h hb hu hz hL); change Tendsto w atTop (𝓝 (Vivid (Zᵣ) (BornZ none))) at hZ; rw [hx] at hZ; constructor
    · have ht:= he.sub hZ; rw [zero_sub,neg_neg] at ht; exact ht

proof_context.conclusion: medium = beta^{-1} Shine5 X - Shine5 L.Z tends to Stem5 (the equation vector), since beta^{-1} Shine5 X -> 0 and the current read-out tends to Vivid(BornZ none) = -Stem5 with Lease(Stem5)=0; also taxA * Lease(medium) -> 0.

lemma Lease_alive (F':Frame G 5) (hG:G.Simple): Lease F' hG (Stem5 F')=0:=by
   change rho hG ((plate F') (Stem5 F')) = _; rw[Stem5,LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]; exact rho_eom hG _ (fun i=> eom_null i)

proof_context.conclusion: rho_tr vanishes on the equation vector Stem5 (via rho_eom).

lemma diadem : Tendsto (fun k=> taxA (A) k*(Lease (Zᵣ) h (Shine5 Z L.Z k)-Lease (Zᵣ) h (Vivid (Zᵣ) (BornZ i)))) atTop (𝓝 0):=by
   let V:= Vivid (Zᵣ) (BornZ i);let ρ:=Lease (Zᵣ) h; let T:= OrbitR (Zᵣ); have hP:∀ᶠ k in atTop, ‖ρ (Shine5 Z L.Z k)-ρ V‖ ≤ ‖ρ‖*(‖T‖*loss (A) k):=by
        filter_upwards [shipping hz hV,article h hu i 1 zero_lt_one,roofs P h hb hu hV] with k hk ht he
        refine le_of_tendsto (f:=fun p:ℕ×ℕ=>‖ρ (T (Roll k p L.Z))-ρ V‖) (((ρ.continuous.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hk.2).sub_const (ρ V)).norm) ?_; filter_upwards [ht,he] with p ht hu
        obtain ⟨w,hw,h₁,h₂,h₃⟩:=ht; have hp : ρ V= ρ (T (coin5 k p t i)):=by rw [h₂]; unfold ρ V; rw[leaseV,leaseV,h₃]
        rw [hp]; exact lace ρ _ _ _ (lace T _ _ _ hu.2)
   apply tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero.mpr; have hv :Tendsto (fun i=> ‖ρ‖*‖T‖*AgeK A (1/5+ -(1/4:ℝ)) i) atTop (𝓝 0):= by simpa using (Age_rate A (by norm_num:1/5+ -(1/4:ℝ)<0) h).const_mul (‖ρ‖*‖T‖)
   refine squeeze_zero' (Eventually.of_forall fun i=>norm_nonneg _) ?_ hv; filter_upwards[hP] with i hi
   have ht :0 ≤ taxA A i:=Zn.wake ..|>.le; change ‖taxA A i*(ρ _-ρ V)‖ ≤_; rw[norm_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg ht]; apply le_trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hi ht); rw [← AgeK_mul]; change taxA A i*(‖ρ‖*(‖T‖*loss (A) i)) ≤ ‖ρ‖*‖T‖*(taxA A i*loss A i); apply le_of_eq; ring

proof_context.conclusion: taxA k * (Lease(Shine5 L.Z k) - Lease(Vivid ..)) -> 0, comparing the current coefficient with its read-out at rate loss = AgeK(-1/4).
